# Bundled fonts (timer digits)

All fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see the OFL-*.txt files here)
and are bundled in `app/src/main/res/font/` so the app works fully offline.

- Outfit ExtraBold (`outfit_extrabold.ttf`): static ExtraBold instance cut from the variable
  Outfit font, with its tabular (equal-width) digits made the default so the timer doesn't jitter.
- JetBrains Mono ExtraBold (`jetbrains_mono_extrabold.ttf`)
- Bebas Neue (`bebas_neue_regular.ttf`)
- DSEG7 Classic Bold (`dseg7_classic_bold.ttf`): seven-segment digital-clock style
